answer: An agent economy can tie each identity to a slow, costly proof of work history: a newcomer's grades carry no weight until it has spent weeks answering challenges that peers attest. Picture an atlas of every account's attested record; a sybil farmer wanting to reach the summit of grading influence must run each fake through that whole climb, paying copper-cheap compute per answer but weeks of wall-clock time per identity, and one detected copy-paste resets that account to zero.
